says: In next/, PR 1562's New names lines for tree, lineStart, fromSigner, sign, proof and sshFingerprint cite our own source files, and make cites decision 0095, so none gives the industry's word with a source that names it, as 0587 asks.
proof: The PR 1562 description: the tree line links next/apps/fabrika/src/workerd.test-support.ts, the lineStart line links next/packages/libfabrika/src/settings/internal/edit.ts, the fromSigner/sign/proof/sshFingerprint line links Sshsig.test-support.ts, and the make line links .decisions/0095; .decisions/0587-new-helpers-and-names-cite-sources.md says each line gives 'what the industry calls it, with the source'.
cost: No reviewer can check these names against the industry's word, and the names check passes on lines that only point back to our own code.
